name: json-3.12.0 (nlohmann-json)
title: json-3.12.0 (nlohmann-json)
summary: The nlohmann-json package provides a header-only in-memory JSON and interface library for C++. The package is simply called “json”, but most refer to it as “nlohmann json” to reduce ambiguity, and is done so here.
build_time: less than 0.1 SBU (add 5.8 SBU for tests)
